name: Witch Hunter Shadowhounds wear Pet Avoidance (#7362)
contract: Live parity: in live CoA combat logs (2026-06-06 and 2026-06-08) one creature area cast hit players for 31-74 and the Shadowhound and Lesser Shadowhounds beside them for 2-5, the -90% creature area damage that 32233 'Pet Avoidance' (aura 310 -90% creature area damage, aura 229 -20%) gives the stock guardians. Neither hound gets it from its data: CreatureFamily 551 'Shadowhound' lists only skill line 11805, not 'Pet - Generic Hunter' 270 that teaches hunter pets 65220 'Avoidance'. Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 summons the Shadowhound 50124 as the pet; Unleash the Hounds 807933 summons Lesser Shadowhounds 50224 as guardians. Expected: both wear 32233. Before the fix neither did.
